description: Source code for a Python-based DELTA Robot Arm to ROS2 Topic Compiler, converting DELTA API calls into ROS2 commands for industrial automation, including command parsing, mapping, and code generation.

classes.name: CommandType
classes.description: Enumeration of DELTA command types such as movement, I/O control, sensor read, modbus, wait, and function call.

classes.name: ROS2Command
classes.description: Data class representing a ROS2 command with topic, message type, data payload, and description.

classes.name: DeltaToROS2Compiler
classes.description: Main class that parses DELTA code, identifies command types, compiles them into ROS2 commands, and generates launch and bash scripts.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the compiler with mappings for stations, I/O, and sensors.

methods.name: parse_delta_code
methods.description: Parses raw DELTA code into individual command lines, removing comments and empty lines.

methods.name: identify_command_type
methods.description: Determines the type of DELTA command based on regex pattern matching.

methods.name: compile_movement_command
methods.description: Converts movement commands (MovP/MovL) into ROS2 commands for moving the robot arm.

methods.name: compile_io_command
methods.description: Converts digital output commands into ROS2 commands for I/O control.

methods.name: compile_sensor_command
methods.description: Converts sensor read commands into ROS2 commands for sensor status.

methods.name: compile_modbus_command
methods.description: Converts Modbus read/write commands into ROS2 service requests.

methods.name: compile_wait_command
methods.description: Converts wait commands into ROS2 commands for synchronization based on sensor states.

methods.name: compile_test_control
methods.description: Generates test control commands for specific fixture actions.

methods.name: compile_line
methods.description: Processes a single line of DELTA code into corresponding ROS2 commands.

methods.name: compile_file
methods.description: Processes entire DELTA code into a list of ROS2 commands.

methods.name: generate_ros2_launch_file
methods.description: Creates a ROS2 launch script that starts necessary nodes for the robot system.

methods.name: generate_bash_script
methods.description: Creates a bash script to publish ROS2 commands based on the compiled command list.
